title: HoverPad v2.7.2 — Automatic Update Pop-Up Notification & Cloud Workspace Join
notes: Added a floating Update Pop-Up Notification card whenever a new HoverPad update is available or downloaded.
One-click 'Update & Reload Now' or 'Later' directly from the pop-up card.
Enabled seamless 8-character invite code workspace joining for both Guest and signed-in users.
